 -- |Base error class.

  -- The explicit use of this constructor is not advised. Use the QL_FAIL macro instead.
  Error
   ->
   ::const std::string &

   -- ^line
   ::const std::string &

   =""
   -- ^message
  -- the automatically generated destructor would not have the throw specifier.
